name: Object Combination Operators
definition: Operators to combine two SDFs (distances `a` and `b`) to produce rounded edges, chamfers, stairs, etc., instead of sharp boolean edges. They aim to produce correct distances or distance bounds, unlike popular 'smooth minimum' operators.
summary: Object Combination Operators merge two Signed Distance Functions into a single field using a radius parameter to create rounded edges, preserving Lipschitz continuity better than standard boolean logic.
